history_coverage: Compare milliseconds per newly covered source; report raw counts (before 300, after 320) and action counts too.
live_stream: Require complete corrected-reference and after renderers and multiple intermediate renders. Invalid renderers fail acceptance; never report their speed ratio. The unmodified original is checked separately and excluded from live ratios.
rss: Cumulative process peak only; no claim about scenario-local allocation.
note: Exploratory single-machine acceptance, not a statistical guarantee. Inspect background-load records. Any changed gate must be documented.
